audience: shops and brands that run a points loyalty program on Leat

useCases.title: Look up a loyalty contact and balances
useCases.text: Find a contact by email. Read the credit balance, the prepaid balance and the loyalty tier of that contact.

useCases.title: Review orders and their contacts
useCases.text: List orders by creation date, or find one order by its external id. Open an order to read its line items.

useCases.title: Review points earned and rewards redeemed
useCases.text: List loyalty transactions, filtered by type, business profile and date. Open one manual points transaction to read it.

useCases.title: Create a contact or change points
useCases.text: Create a loyalty contact with an email address. Add or subtract points for a contact, but only after you approve the amount.

useCases.title: Reverse a points transaction
useCases.text: Undo one direct points transaction by its UUID. Use it only after you approve the reversal, because it changes real balances.
